children: According to CNBC, LeBron James teased an upcoming partnership with prediction market platform Polymarket in a social media post on Saturday. James posted a 14-second video on X that appeared to be an advertisement for Polymarket and wrote, "Welcome to Polymarket HQ. Coming soon. In partnership with @Polymarket," while a person familiar with the matter said the broader campaign is expected to focus on football and that further details are expected in the week ahead.

title: LeBron James Teases Partnership With Polymarket
